issue.title: Better-Auth Integeration
issue.body:
### Description
Fluent Mobile currently relies on the insecure `x-user-email` header and a static environment variable (`FLUENT_USER_EMAIL`) for data synchronization. We need to implement a user-facing Login/Forgot Password flow and migrate the networking layer to use Bearer token authentication stored securely on the device.

### Requirements & Scope

1. **Secure Storage Integration**:
   - Add `"react-native-keychain"` to dependencies.
   - Implement helper functions (`src/services/keychain.ts`) to securely store, retrieve, and delete the token under a custom service name (e.g. `'fluent_session'`).
   - Non-sensitive user details (username, email, ID) can be stored in plain KV storage, but credentials must reside in Keychain (iOS) / Keystore (Android).

2. **API Layer Refactoring**:
   - Modify the fetch request wrapper in `src/services/api.ts` to automatically retrieve the Bearer token from Keychain and inject `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
   - Send `x-client-type: mobile` and `User-Agent: FluentMobile` headers globally.
   - Remove legacy `x-user-email` headers and arguments.

3. **Login UI & Auth Navigation**:
   - Design a polished, modern Login Screen (`LoginScreen.tsx`) using Fluent styling.
   - Set up an `AuthNavigator` stack. Wrap the app's root navigation in a conditional check:
     - If a valid token is found, render the main `AppNavigator`.
     - Otherwise, render the `AuthNavigator`.

4. **E2E Sign-in, Forgot Password & Sign-out Flow**:
   - **Sign-in**: Call `/api/auth/sign-in/email`, extract the `set-auth-token` header, and save it to the secure Keychain. Store user details locally and navigate to the Projects list.
   - **Forgot Password**: On the login screen, add a "Forgot Password?" link to request a reset email via `/api/auth/forget-password`.
   - **Sign-out**: Call `/api/auth/sign-out`, clear the stored keychain token, clear local databases/caches, and redirect to the Login Screen.

5. **Token Expiration Handling**:
   - In the API wrapper, if a request fails with 401 containing `"Session token has expired"`, display a friendly prompt, clear the keychain token, and redirect to the Login Screen.

6. **Privacy Policy & Terms of Use**:
   - On the Login Screen, add links to the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use pages.

comments.body:
1. Using "react-native-keychain" is the right call here. It is essentially just a maintained wrapper so we don't have to write and maintain the Java/Kotlin bridge ourselves to the [Keystore](https://developer.android.com/privacy-and-security/keystore#WhichShouldIUse). 
2. The `x-client-type: mobile` and `User-Agent: FluentMobile` headers are an acceptable practice. Though, this can be inferred by the mobile requests being the only ones to include the `Auth Bearer <token>` header as well.
